intro.text: A low-ranking member of the wall guard at Feverstone Keep, long ago.

items.text: In one of his visions, Dalinar lived through a day at Feverstone Keep as Leef.

appearance.text: He wears a simple uniform of cloth skirt, leather jerkin, cloak and bronze cap, and carries a spear with a fine steel head.

personality.text: Like several of his fellow guards he isn't known for staying alert, and his colleagues dislike him.
